name: DCBA
summary: DCBA is a KEK detector-development programme for double-beta decay. It measures the momenta and trajectories of the two emitted electrons, providing kinematic information complementary to a calorimetric energy measurement.
detection_principle: A thin isotope foil is placed in a magnetic tracking detector. Drift-chamber hit positions reconstruct electron helices and curvature, allowing a momentum estimate and a common-vertex requirement.

science_scope: A neutrinoless double-beta-decay signal would establish lepton-number violation. Converting a half-life constraint into an effective Majorana mass requires a decay mechanism and nuclear matrix elements; a null search is not a neutrino-mass measurement.
